explanation: Kinematics W=1.6 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV2, cos(theta*)=0.5, phi*=90 deg are physically valid for eta electroproduction on the proton (ep -> e'p eta) at CLAS12: W is well above the eta production threshold (m_p+m_eta ~ 1.486 GeV), the implied electron scattering angle at bmom=6.535 GeV gives a physical epsilon_d in (0,1), and the unconstrained inelasticity limit vmax (~0.227 GeV^2 at this point) exceeds the standard CLAS12 cut vcut=0.166 GeV^2, so the cut is applied normally without zeroing the phase space. This exact point (W=1.6, Q2=1.0, cos=0.5, phi=90) also appears verbatim as one of the 5 rows in the repo's own template eta/input.dat, confirming it is a previously validated configuration for the EtaMAID-2023 tables (which span Q2 in [0,5] GeV^2 and W in [1.4856,6] GeV). I generated a single-point EXCLURAD input file (input_eta_W1.6_Q2_1.0_cos0.5_phi90.dat) using the standard CLAS12 settings documented in eta/README.md and eta/examples/README.md: model=3 (EtaMAID/maid2000), rc_mode=0 (full O(alpha) radiative correction), bmom=6.535 GeV (CLAS12 beam momentum), lepton=1 (electron), ivec=1 (detected recoil proton), vcut=0.166 GeV^2 (CLAS12 eta-analysis inelasticity cut). No compiler/shell is available in this environment, so the file is ready to run as `./build/exclurad.exe < input_eta_W1.6_Q2_1.0_cos0.5_phi90.dat` on a system with the built exclurad.exe; outputs (radcor.dat, radtot.dat, etc.) will contain the RC factor sigma_obs/sigma_Born (delta) and the asymmetry ratio A_RC/A_Born for this point.
